text:
joan: Quick check-in: proposing to pull session-tiling out of inference-runtime into a small co-located tiler and a separate metadata service. Objective: reduce hotpath churn and speed up runtime deploys.

liam: +1 on intent. Main risks: added RPC on hotpath and migration of existing session keys.

ravi: For migration we should dual-write for a window and run shadow reads to detect diffs. Reconciler can replay mismatches.

joan: Agreed. Plan sketch: 1) runtime façade calls tiler (co-located) for hot ops; 2) metadata-plane is canonical for profiles and rollouts; 3) dual-write keys during migration; 4) flip reads per-tenant.

liam: Perf targets? We need sub-200us p95 for tiler hop. If not, feature-flag fallback to local tiler code.

ops-bot: [canary] inference-tiler:v0.1-canary - 2/2 pods up, p95 +110us vs baseline.

hen: Owners/timeline?

joan: Owners: liam -> tiler placement, ravi -> migration/reconciler, hen -> runbook + admin toggles. Timeline: 2-week spike, staging canary week 3, slow prod ramp week 5.

liam: I'll prototype sidecar placement and measure tail. If latency too high we'll try process-shared placement.

ravi: I'll scaffold a reconciler that writes repaired v2 keys and exposes /replay. Add metrics: mismatch_rate and reconciliation_lag.

joan: Rollback: runtime keeps a cached fallback tiler and an admin flag to force-local. Abort canary on p95>2x or error_rate>0.5%.

hen: Add a short checklist before tenant flips: reconciler zero, health ok 30m, no active rollouts.

joan: Thanks. I'll open the RFC PR with the contract and sketch. Comments welcome. :thumbsup:
